component.name: Atomic Basejump
component.summary: Manage rpm-ostree deployments and base images on Fedora Atomic

description.p: Atomic Basejump is a desktop application for managing rpm-ostree system deployments and OCI base images on Fedora Atomic desktops (Kinoite, Aurora, Bazzite, Silverblue, and related images).
It ships dual native frontends — Kirigami (Plasma) and Libadwaita (GNOME) — selected by desktop environment or user preference, sharing a single Python core.

Status and deployment lists come from the system D-Bus interface of rpm-ostreed. System mutations (upgrade, rebase, rollback, pin, package layers) run host rpm-ostree / ostree via the Flatpak portal so transactions complete outside the sandbox. This application is therefore a system utility and is not intended for strict-sandbox catalogs such as Flathub without host access.
